correctness.rationale: Direct proof: positive pre-hit solutions satisfy q'= -a q-cp; biomass H is nonincreasing and prevents blow-up; any global positive solution has integrable prey, a=beta+L1 error and predator p~C exp(-mu t). The integrating-factor integral then forces a finite hit for mu<=beta. For mu>beta exponential comparison establishes a strict no-hit wedge and large-introduction finite-hit bounds for every s0. All boundary cases, exponent assumptions and exact example inequalities were checked with the delivered self-contained script; finite numeric runs are illustrative only.

value.rationale: The existing source uses an assumed maintained predator pressure to force finite-time extinction, leaving unknown whether endogenous predator loss permits only asymptotic prey death. The exact cutoff mu=(1-r)bL resolves all initial conditions on one side and proves both clocks exist for each initial prey density on the other, with a biologically motivated quantitative bridge between predator turnover and Allee mortality. It is a natural structural classification rather than a generic algebraic restatement or an arbitrary parameter substitution.
